notes.title: "Final_SIM" RELEASED!!!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone, I am excited to announce that "Final_SIM" is OFFICIALLY LAUNCHED![/h1]

Thank you to [b]EVERYONE[/b] who made this possible and supported me along the way. I truly want to thank [u]each and every one of you[/u] who play my game. It means the world to me <3.

Have fun!
